rowagency.text: The agency's five frames, as delivered

rowpick.text: The same five screens in 50pick's own design system

hdrfit.text: Measured in Chromium at 320/360/390/412 in sw/en/zh with balances up to TZS 10,000,000. From 360 up: the product's 26-px mark, 6-px gaps, slimmer pill padding. Below 360: a 12-px gutter, "Weka pesa" without the "+", a 12-px figure. The figure is gold, as the product's wallet pill paints it (R1). One 18+ roundel everywhere (.kp-rg__18). Held wallet: the existing "Salio · limegandishwa" with a lock, and no Weka pesa pill — a frozen wallet cannot take deposits. Guest pills are 44 px tall.

rowcards.text: 3 · The journey card in every state

cardwords.text: Wording: "Kuwa wa kwanza" is SJ-1's word, drawn as a new short key (the existing beFirst wraps at every width). A figure never leaves its unit: "≈2.8× dau", "1 Oktoba", "10 Okt" are joined by a no-break space. Over the 100× cap the card shows no number — "Upande mdogo, ona makadirio" — because the zero-stake multiple over-promises once a real stake joins the small side; a thin side (≈1.0×) reads "Faida ndogo · ≈1.0×" (SJ-1 amended after the panel; both drafts). Button content is top-aligned, so the side words share a line when one second line wraps.

cardlegacy.text: Legacy capped market: the card shows the side word alone (describeFeeModel is English admin text). The sheet names the commission in a drafted player sentence: "Kamisheni ya hadi 10% ya bwawa lote hutolewa kabla washindi hawajalipwa." — the capped fee is min(10% of the pool, a third of the smaller side), so "up to 10% of the whole pool" is always true.

rowhome.text: 3 · Home · loading, chips, empty, end of page, on a break, desktop

homedrafts.text: Draft words — no string exists yet: "Kripto: hakuna maswali wazi kwa sasa", "Maswali mapya yataonekana hapa yakichapishwa.", "Onyesha maswali yote"; on a break: "Uko kwenye mapumziko hadi 8 Okt, 14:30", "Kuweka dau kumezimwa hadi wakati huo. Unaweza kuendelea kuangalia maswali.", "Mapumziko hadi 8 Okt". On a break the cards show no multiples at all, and the header drops "+ Weka pesa": a payment that lands during a break is held and returned (the waiting row's "held" frame). The first page ends in close order (soonest first, SJ-6). The footer carries the helpline and the licence number (SJ-24).

rowsheet.text: 4 · The bet sheet · choosing, and every kind of estimate

sheetcalls.text: Design calls. Every estimate carries ≈ — the figure and the multiple chip — and the chip sits on its own row in every state. Bounds: the first sentence of today's refusal, in the kit's info notice; the figure shows "TZS —" and the button reads "Weka dau" with no amount (§3.3). Each sheet has one hidden polite live region that reads the new figure aloud when it changes. Empty side: the sheet prints the figure at a real stake and says it will fall as others join. Empty pool: no figure. Over the cap at the stake: the figure is printed and the chip reads "≈ zaidi ya 100×". Hedge: the existing hedge sentence, in the info notice. Unknown balance: "Salio lako —" and the button stays live; the server decides.

rowsheet2.text: 4 · The bet sheet · placing, closed, the limits, refusals, keyboard, desktop

sheetfinds.text: The limits and refusals. A stake above the loss-limit room is never pre-filled to the room: the stake stays as typed, the notice says what the limit allows, chips above the room hide, the button is disabled (§3.5 amended — pre-filling nudges a player to use up their limit). The blocking refusals carry no side chip, carry the helpline, and stack their buttons full-width. The receipt does not close itself. Drafts: "Kikomo chako cha hasara kinaruhusu hadi TZS 3,000 leo.", "Jisajili uweke dau", "Makadirio yamesasishwa", the empty-side and empty-pool lines. formatDeadline prints English months in Swahili ("8 Oct") — an S12 finding; the frames show "8 Okt".

rowlow.text: 5 · Balance too low · every variant the engine can return

lownotes.text: Each frame is a branch of shortfallPlan (lib/journey/shortfall.ts). The two-option state is the 50pick redraw in row 2. "Weka dau la TZS 2,000 badala yake" places the bet in one tap, so it carries its own estimate on a second line (SJ-11 amended); both option rows are the same height and the gold row has no glow. A held wallet never reaches this screen: the plan blocks it first. With one option the eyebrow is dropped. When no deposit is offered, the reason is shown before the player tries, in the info notice. Drafts: "Kiasi cha chini cha kuweka ni TZS 500 — TZS 300 zitabaki kwenye salio lako." (⚠️ from the owner's ruling of 2026-10-07, a TZS 1,000 minimum: "Kiasi cha chini cha kuweka ni TZS 1,000 — TZS 800 zitabaki kwenye salio lako.", as the board now draws it), "Malipo yako ya TZS 3,000 yanasubiri", "Fuatilia malipo", "Jaza tamko".

rowdeposit.text: 6 · Deposit · the deposit variants (the email-code boards ⛔ superseded 2026-10-07: a deposit asks no email question)

depnotes.text: ⛔ The code step is superseded by the owner's ruling of 2026-10-07 (a deposit asks no email question; S9 is not built): its words below are kept as drawn, and the rest of this note still holds. The code step sits between the PIN note and "Lipa" (§3.5 order 9); one one-time-code input drawn as six cells; Lipa enables on success without re-entering anything. A wrong code is a form error in the kit's danger ink (the S2 ruling); every other state is neutral, including "Msimbo mpya umetumwa.". The payout notice uses the kit's info notice and shows the delayed words (F1). Phone numbers are Inter with tabular figures; only amounts are mono. Drafts: "Tuma msimbo", "Thibitisha barua pepe yako ili uweke pesa".

waitnotes.text: The waiting page uses the focused chrome and the 18+ and helpline line (SJ-18). Paid does not redirect by itself: the player taps "Rudi kwenye dau" (WCAG 2.2.1). Failed keeps the pending-bet strip. Past 30 minutes: still unconfirmed, the reference and Msaada. Held for return: a payment that landed during a break is returned by the team (wallet-service) — the period "siku 3 za kazi" is to be confirmed there. The return never pre-fills the loss-limit room. Drafts: "Weka PIN kwenye simu yako", "Usianzishe malipo mengine.", "Angalia hali ya malipo", "Hakuna pesa iliyokatwa", "Pesa zako zitarudishwa" and its sentence, "Malipo bado hayajathibitishwa" and its sentence, "Maswali yanayofanana", "Weka pesa tena" (plan).

rowhowto.text: 7 · How to Play · English, Chinese, 320×640, desktop

howtonotes.text: Step numerals are neutral (1B): gold on a decorative element breaks DESIGN_AUTHORITY §M3. MFANO sits after the steps, not inside the list, and ends with the deck's estimate line. The steps region is focusable and named for keyboard scrolling. At 320×640 the sheet is capped at the viewport minus 48 px and the spacing is tightened (never the type) until MFANO's last line — the loss sentence and the estimate line — sits above the pinned "Nimeelewa, anza"; nothing has to scroll. Chinese quotes the side words 「是」「否」 inside sentences and says winners share the pool in proportion to their stakes. Chinese uses keep-all (R8).

rowakaunti.text: 8 · Akaunti · signed in, guest, the staff row

akauntinotes.text: SJ-17's items grouped into cards without headings; the limits card now comes before invite and rewards, and carries a Pumzika / Jizuie row (SJ-17 amended after the panel). Every label is today's key except the plan's "Toa pesa" and the corrected "Ukubwa wa kadi" and "Maswali ya kawaida"; Msaada shows the helpline number. Alika and Pendekeza show only when inviteIsLiveFor / proposalsState allow; the staff row ("Wafanyakazi tu", draft) is a plain link to /admin, staff only. The unread count rides on Arifa and as a dot on the Akaunti tab, with hidden text for screen readers. "Jina Lako" is a placeholder name.

row_tiketinotes.text: 9 · Tiketi zangu · open, settled, empty, guest

tiketinotes.text: The page is renamed "Tiketi zangu" (SJ-19). Open tickets show no payout figure before resolution — "Malipo · Matokeo yakitoka" (SJ-4 keeps §C3). Every timer names its absolute instant ("Uza bila ada hadi 11:23 · 3:42" — the free exit is the first 5 minutes after placing, so the open Dodoma ticket was placed at 11:18; the Yanga ticket, placed on 28 Sep, is past its window). Selling is one verb: "Uza bila ada" inside the free window, then "Kuuza kumefungwa". The settled tickets are two questions that closed before today: the Simba win is real arithmetic on its final pool (TZS 1,000 on NDIO, pool 30,000 / 42,000 → TZS 2,218). Drafts: "Bado huna tiketi hai", its sentence, "Tazama maswali", "Ingia uone tiketi zako" (plan).

row_marketnotes.text: 10–11 · The market page, and Juu/Chini in the same language

marketnotes.text: Market page (§3.2): full wording, source, pool ("Bwawa"), chart, both countdowns each with its absolute time, then the holder's ticket block above the two big buttons, which show the side words only — an estimate is licensed only on the cards and in the sheet (SJ-4), and the sheet the buttons open shows it. The chart follows the four-ink chart law: a gilt dashed 50 line, green above, rose below, the value tag in the leading side's ink — at 33% NDIO that is rose. The pool is the real Dodoma sum (24,825 + 50,462 = TZS 75,287). Juu/Chini: the side is chosen before the low-balance offer, because a pending Juu/Chini bet needs a side; the × multiples carry ≈ and the existing note that they move with every bet.

focusnotes.text: Keyboard focus: the product's own .btn:focus-visible ring (2-px brand-500 outline, 2-px offset, a soft 4-px halo) on every control family; the gold button keeps a real outline (DESIGN_AUTHORITY §M3, E-129); wallet rows and the stake and phone fields show it with :focus-within. Reduced motion: no shimmer, no press-pop, sheets fade instead of slide, spinners become a static icon, countdowns tick by the minute.
